messages:
Maya: Quick mid-Q check on OKR milestones — can teams call out what actually shipped vs slipped this sprint? Trying to update the board before Friday. KRs: KR1 (Serving latency), KR2 (Console rollouts), KR3 (Dedicated capacity onboarding).

Sam: KR1: shipped core batching improvements to prod yesterday. End-to-end p95 latency down ~12% on benchmark. Need follow-up CR for metrics dashboard (PR open). :rocket:

Priya: KR2: console feature flag rollout partially shipped. Canary went fine but we found a UI regression in settings modal; reverted canary. Owner: @Priya. ETA for fix: EOW. PR: https://git.internal/r/2345

Arjun: KR3: Dedicated onboarding — infra side is blocked on signer integration from security (ticket S-88). Owning infra work; need product signoff for beta customers. @Maya can you confirm list of beta tenants?

Lucy: FYI design will push the simplified onboarding copy by tomorrow. Small change, no UX blockers.

Maya: @Arjun — beta list: acme-inc, monolith-ai, stellar-pay. Will follow up via doc. Also, can we add fallback policy for Dedicated to rollback if signer isn't ready?

Arjun: Yes, we can toggle fallback to hosted for those tenants. I'll add a rollout plan in the draft (link in PR).

Sam: About the metrics dashboard PR — pinging @Priya and @Lucy for a quick design + product sanity check. PR: https://git.internal/r/2377. It needs a tiny label change.

Priya: Reviewing now, should be a 1h pass. If green, can merge and schedule a deploy window.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: staging -> prod at 2026-03-20T02:00Z (if PRs merged).

Maya: Action items: (1) @Sam merge metrics PR once @Priya approves, (2) @Priya patch settings modal + open fix PR, (3) @Arjun add rollback plan + confirm beta tenants, (4) @Lucy landing copy tomorrow. I'll update the OKR board after each done. Anything else?

Sam: Adding CR ping to the PR and tagging oncall for monitoring baseline.

Priya: I'll open the fix PR today and add QA notes.

Arjun: Will post rollback steps and status by EOD. If blocker cleared, we can start onboarding next week.

Lucy: I'll upload copy to the Figma file and ping here.

Maya: Thanks all :thumbsup: I'll reconvene Fri standup if any slips. If anything urgent, DM me.
